caption_provider_id.hint: Leave empty to use AstrBot's provider setting 'default_image_caption_provider_id'. If that is also empty, the session's image-capable chat provider is used when possible.

caption_prompt.hint: Leave empty to use AstrBot's provider setting 'image_caption_prompt'.

caption_timeout_seconds.hint: Maximum time allowed for captioning one image. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.
